One blocking issue: initial publication can accept a sealed baseline that omits a declaration loaded concurrently through the legacy loader. Recheck projected declaration IDs under the publication lock at revision 0 and test bootstrap resume after an intervening legacy load.

No other material correctness gaps found. Review and evidence audit: [review.md](/tmp/exposed-delta-architecture/review.md).
